The server is intentionally lightweight: no\nActive Record models, no view layer, no background jobs, and only the\n`action_controller` and `railtie` parts of Rails are loaded.\n\n## Starting and verifying the server\n\nThe server is started from the project root with the provided wrapper:\n\n```bash\nPORT=4567 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` runs `bundle exec rackup -o 127.0.0.1 -p \"$PORT\"` in the foreground, so\nPuma listens on the requested host and port and logs to stdout. To verify it:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:4567/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nA smoke test that exercises the main endpoints is:\n\n```bash\nBASE=http://127.0.0.1:4567\ncurl -X POST \"$BASE/v1/storage/reset\"\ncurl -X POST \"$BASE/v1/auth/register\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"username\":\"dm\",\"password\":\"password123\",\"role\":\"dm\"}'\ncurl -X POST \"$BASE/v1/dice/stats\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"expression\":\"2d6+3\"}'\n```\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n| File / Directory | Purpose |\n| ---------------- | ------- |\n| `run.sh` | Foreground server wrapper. Uses `PORT` and binds to `127.0.0.1`. |\n| `config.ru` | Rack entry point. Loads `app.rb` and mounts `Rails.application`. |\n| `app.rb` | Defines the Rails application (`Dnd::Application`), loads the shared\n  storage module, and initializes the database. |\n| `config/routes.rb` | All HTTP routes grouped by domain. One explicit route per\n  endpoint, no resource macros. |\n| `app/controllers/` | One controller per domain. All inherit from\n  `ApplicationController`, which parses JSON bodies and provides shared 400/401\n  helpers. |\n| `app/controllers/concerns/dnd_rules.rb` | Shared domain rules and validation\n  helpers: initiative math, encounter difficulty, identifier validation,\n  ability modifiers, proficiency bonuses, and `find_campaign`. |\n| `app/models/game_storage.rb` | Shared SQLite3 persistence module. Bypasses\n  Active Record and uses raw SQL plus a global mutex for write safety. |\n| `Gemfile` / `Gemfile.lock` | Pinned dependency set: Rails 8.1.3, Puma 8.0.2,\n  Rack 3.2.6, Rackup 2.3.1, SQLite3, BCrypt. |\n\n## State, persistence, and request routing\n\n### Persistence\n\nState lives in a single SQLite3 database file named `game.db` in the project\nroot. The schema is created by `GameStorage.init` on startup, so the server is\nself-initializing. Tables include:\n\n- `users` — DM/player accounts with BCrypt password digests.\n- `combat_sessions` — active combat order and conditions as JSON columns.\n- `monsters` and `items` — compendium entries.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — campaign state.\n- `quests`, `factions`, `npcs` — campaign narrative state.\n- `inventory` — campaign inventory entries and assigned equipment.\n- `crafting_projects` — downtime crafting progress.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled sessions and attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members`, `play_campaign_events` —\n  authenticated turn-based play surface.\n- `play_campaign_documents` — public story and private DM notes.\n- `play_campaign_scenes` — scenes that can be opened, entered, and closed.\n- `play_campaign_locations`, `play_campaign_location_connections` — location\n  graph and travel edges.\n- `play_campaign_encounters` — combat encounters with combatants, conditions,\n  turn order, and rewards.\n- `play_campaign_spells` — per-character spellbook entries validated against the\n  character's class.\n- `schema_version` — schema marker used by the storage status endpoint.\n\nThe connection is opened lazily by `GameStorage.db`. All writes and any\nread-modify-write sequence are wrapped in `GameStorage.with_lock` because the\nPuma server runs multi-threaded and the SQLite3 build in this workspace is not\nconfigured for concurrent writers.\n\n`GameStorage.init` calls `create_schema` (the single source of truth for a\nfresh database) and then a compact set of migrations grouped by table:\n`migrate_play_campaigns`, `migrate_play_events`, `migrate_play_members`,\n`migrate_play_documents`, `migrate_play_scenes`, `migrate_play_locations`, and\n`migrate_play_encounters`. Each migration is idempotent: it adds missing\ncolumns or creates missing tables only when they are absent. The `reset`\nendpoint drops every managed table and recreates them from `create_schema`, so\ntests always start from a deterministic, empty state.\n\n### Request routing\n\nRoutes are explicit in `config/routes.rb`. No namespaces, no generated helpers.\nEach route maps a verb + path to a single controller action. For example:\n\n```ruby\npost '/v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance', to: 'combat_sessions#advance'\n```\n\nPath parameters are available through `params[:id]`, and the parsed JSON body is\navailable through the `@body` instance variable populated by\n`ApplicationController#parse_json_body`.\n\n### Controllers\n\n`ApplicationController` is the API base. It:\n\n1. Runs `before_action :parse_json_body` for every action.\n2. Returns `400 { error: 'invalid json' }` if the body is malformed.\n3. Provides `bad_request(message)` for 400 responses.\n4. Provides `require_authentication` and `require_dm` for the play surface.\n\n`DndRules` is included in `ApplicationController` so every concrete controller\nhas access to shared validation (`valid_id?`, `valid_non_empty_string?`) and\nD&D 5e math (`initiative_order`, `build_party_thresholds`, `modifier_for`,\n`proficiency_bonus`, etc.). It also provides `find_campaign(id)` for 404-aware\ncampaign lookups.\n\nConcrete controllers keep validation and domain logic together. They return the\nexact JSON shapes the cumulative evaluator expects. :create_encounter, :add_monster, :remove_monster, :bind_member, :unbind_member, :damage, :heal, :character_damage, :add_condition, :rewards, :close_encounter, :end_encounter]\n  before_action :require_player, only: [:add_member, :my_turn, :death_saves]\n\n  ABILITY_NAMES = %w[str dex con int wis cha].freeze\n  VALID_RACES = %w[dwarf elf halfling human dragonborn gnome half-elf half-orc  acrobatics\n    sleight_of_hand\n    stealth\n    arcana\n    history\n    investigation\n    nature\n    religion\n    animal_handling\n    insight\n    medicine\n    perception\n    survival\n    deception\n    intimidation\n    performance\n    persuasion\n  ].freeze\n\n  WIZARD_SPELLS = %w[\n    acid-splash blade-ward chill-touch dancing-lights fire-bolt friends light\n    mage-hand mending   animate-dead bestow-curse blink clairvoyance counterspell dispel-magic\n    fear feign-death fireball fly gaseous-form glyph-of-warding haste\n    hypnotic-pattern leomunds-tiny-hut lightning-bolt = @body['id']\n    name = @body['name']\n    max_players = @body['max_players']\n\n    unless valid_id?(id)\n      bad_request('invalid id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid name')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless max_players.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid max_players')\n      return\n    end\n\n    owner = @current_user[:username]\n    status = 'lobby'\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      begin\n        GameStorage.db.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO play_campaigns (id, name, owner, status, max_players) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [id, name, owner, status, max_players]\n        )\n        render json: {\n          id: id,\n          name: name,\n          owner: owner,\n          status: status,\n          max_players: max_players\n        }, status: :created\n      rescue SQLite3::ConstraintException\n        render json: { error: 'play campaign id taken' }, status: :conflict\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def add_member\n    character_id = @body['character_id']\n    name = @body['name']\n    class_name = @body['class']\n\n    unless valid_id?(character_id)\n      bad_request('invalid character_id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid name')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless class_name.is_a?(String) && !class_name.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid class')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, status, max_players FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless campaign[1] == 'lobby'\n        render json: { error: 'campaign is not in lobby' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      current_count = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      if current_count >= campaign[2]\n        render json: { error: 'party is full' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      existing_member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND (username = ? OR character_id = ?)',\n        [campaign_id, username, character_id]\n      )\n\n      if existing_member\n        if existing_member[0] == username\n          render json: { error: 'already a member' }, status: :conflict\n        else\n          render json: { error: 'character id taken' }, status: :conflict\n        end\n        return\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_members (campaign_id, username, character_id, name, class, owner) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, username, character_id, name, class_name, username]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        username: username,\n        character_id: character_id,\n        name: name,\n        class: class_name,\n        owner: username\n      }, status: :created\n    end\n  end\n\n  def start\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, status FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      if campaign[1] == 'active'\n        render json: { error: 'campaign already active' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      member_count = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      if member_count < 2\n        render json: { error: 'campaign requires at least two party members' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      current_actor = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY ROWID LIMIT 1',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET status = ?, current_actor = ?, turn_number = ?, nudge_count = 0, turn_deadline = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        ['active', current_actor, 1, 2, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        id: campaign_id,\n        status: 'active',\n        current_actor: current_actor,\n        turn_number: 1\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def narration\n    text = @body['text']\n\n    unless text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid text')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      next_sequence = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_events (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, next_sequence, 'narration', 'dm', text]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        sequence: next_sequence,\n        kind: 'narration',\n        actor: 'dm',\n        text: text\n      }, status: :created\n    end\n  end\n\n  def turn\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, owner, status, current_actor, turn_number, nudge_count, turn_deadline FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      is_owner = campaign[1] == username\n      is_member = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, username]\n      )\n\n      unless is_owner || is_member\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      phase = if campaign[2] == 'active'\n                campaign[3] == campaign[1] ? 'dm' : 'player'\n              else\n                'setup'\n              end\n\n      members = party_usernames(campaign_id)\n      queue = members.flat_map { |username| [username, 'dm'] }\n\n      render json: {\n        campaign_id: campaign[0],\n        current_actor: campaign[3],\n        phase: phase,\n        turn_number: campaign[4],\n        overdue: false,\n        logical_deadline: campaign[4] + 1,\n        queue: queue\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def nudge\n    message = @body['message']\n\n    unless message.is_a?(String) && !message.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid message')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, owner, status, current_actor, nudge_count, turn_deadline FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      unless campaign[2] == 'active'\n        render json: { error: 'campaign is not active' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      new_count = campaign[4] + 1\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_count, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      nudge_sequence = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_events (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, nudge_sequence, 'nudge', username, message]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        actor: username,\n        target: campaign[3],\n        message: message,\n        nudge_count: new_count\n      }, status: :created\n    end\n  end\n\n  def my_turn\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT character_id, name FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY ROWID',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |row|\n        { username: row[0], character_id: row[1], name: row[2], class: row[3] }\n      end\n\n      render json: {\n        needs_attention: needs_attention,\n        current_actor: current_actor,\n        party: party,\n        recent_events: recent_events(campaign_id)\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def action\n    type = @body['type']\n    text = @body['text']\n\n    unless type.is_a?(String) && !type.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid type')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid text')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, owner, status, current_actor, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      if username == campaign[1] || campaign[2] != 'active' || campaign[3] != username\n        render json: { error: 'not your turn' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, username]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      next_sequence = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_events (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text, type, next_actor) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, next_sequence, 'action', username, text, type, 'dm']\n      )\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_deadline = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        ['dm', campaign[4] + 1, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        sequence: next_sequence,\n        kind: 'action',\n        actor: username,\n        type: type,\n        text: text,\n        next_actor: 'dm'\n      }, status: :created\n    end\n  end\n\n  def resolution\n    text = @body['text']\n\n    unless text.is_a?(String) && !text.empty?\n      bad_request('invalid text')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, owner, status, current_actor, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      unless campaign\n        render json: { error: 'campaign not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = campaign[1]\n\n      unless username == owner && campaign[2] == 'active' && campaign[3] == owner\n        render json: { error: 'not your turn' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      members = party_usernames(campaign_id)\n\n      last_player_event = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT actor FROM play_campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ? AND kind IN (?, ?, ?) ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1',\n        [campaign_id, 'action', 'travel', 'rest']\n      )\n\n      next_index = if last_player_event\n                     index = members.index(last_player_event[0])\n                     index ? (index + 1) % members.length : 0\n                   else\n                     0\n                   end\n\n      next_actor = members[next_index]\n      new_turn_number = campaign[4] + 1\n\n      next_sequence = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_events (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text, next_actor) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, next_sequence, 'resolution', owner, text, next_actor]\n      )\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ?, turn_deadline = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [next_actor, new_turn_number, new_turn_number + 1, campaign_id]\n      )\n\n      render json: {\n        sequence: next_sequence,\n        kind: 'resolution',\n        actor: owner,\n        text: text,\n        next_actor: next_actor,\n        turn_number: new_turn_number\n      }, status: :created\n    end\n  end\n\n  def create_scene\n    scene_id = @body['id']\n    name = @body['name']\n\n    unless valid_id?(scene_id)\n      bad_request('invalid id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless valid_non_empty_string?(name)\n      bad_request('invalid name')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless 'INSERT INTO play_campaign_scenes (campaign_id, id, name, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [campaign_id, scene_id, name, 'open']\n        )\n\n        scene_sequence = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n          'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n          campaign_id\n        )\n        GameStorage.db.execute(\n          'INSERT INTO play_campaign_events (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n          [campaign_id, scene_sequence, 'scene', username, scene_id]\n        )\n\n        render json: { id: scene_id, name: name, status: 'open' }, status: :created\n      rescue SQLite3::ConstraintException\n        render json: { error: 'scene id taken' }, status: :conflict\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def enter_scene\n    scene_id = params[:scene_id]\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      scene = find_scene(campaign_id, scene_id)\n      return unless scene\n\n      unless scene[2] == 'open'\n        render json: { error: 'scene is closed' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_scene_id = ? = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == SQLite3::ConstraintException\n        render json: { error: 'location id taken' }, status: :conflict\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def create_connection\n    from_id = params[:from_id]\n    to_id = @body['to_id']\n    travel_turns = @body['travel_turns']\n\n    unless valid_id?(from_id)\n      bad_request('invalid from_id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless valid_id?(to_id)\n      bad_request('invalid to_id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless travel_turns.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid travel_turns')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless campaign[1] == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      from_exists = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_locations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, from_id]\n      )\n      to_exists = GameStorage.db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_locations WHERE campaign_id = ? encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, enc_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      ordered = encounter_turn_order(combatants, encounter[7])\n campaign_id = params[:id]\n    enc_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    target_index = parse_optional_index(@body['index'] || @body['position'])\n    if target_index == :invalid\n      bad_request('invalid index')\n      return\n    end\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless enc_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      ordered = encounter_turn_order(combatants, encounter[7])\n      count = ordered.length\n\n      if ordered[turn_index]\n\n      is_owner = campaign[1] == username\n      is_current = active && active['member'].is_a?(String) && active['member'] == username\n      unless is_owner || is_current\n        render json: { error: 'not your turn' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      target_index = count - 1 if target_index.nil?\n\n      if target_index <= turn_index || target_index >= count\n        bad_request('illegal index')\n        return\n      end\n\n      ordered.delete_at(turn_index)\n      ordered.insert(target_index, active)\n\n      new_order_keys = ordered.map { |c| combatant_key(c) }\n      # The delayed combatant remains the current actor but now occupies the\n      # later position in the order; the next advance will move past them.\n      new_turn_index = username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      unless combatant_exists?(combatants, target)\n        render json: { error: 'target not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      conditions = JSON.parse(encounter[6] || '{}')\n      conditions[target] ||= []\n      conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => duration_rounds }\n\n      GameStorage.db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET conditions_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      unless member\n        render json: { error: 'character not found' }, status: :not_found\n        return\n      end\n\n      owner = member[2]\n      unless owner == username\n        render json: { error: 'forbidden' }, status: :forbidden\n        return\n      end\n\n      abilities = JSON.parse(member[4] || '{}')\n      score = abilities[ability]\n      unless score.is_a?(Integer) && score >= 1 && score <= 30\n        bad_request('invalid ability score')\n        return\n      end\n\n      level = member[3] || 1\n      modifier = modifier_for(score) + (proficient ? proficiency_bonus(level) : 0)\n      total = roll + modifier\n\n      render json: {\n        character_id: char_id,\n        skill: skill,\n        ability: ability,\n        modifier: modifier,\n        total: total\n      }, status: :ok\n    end\n  end\n\n  def add_spell\n    spell_id = @body['spell_id']\n    name = @body['name']\n    level = @body['level']\n\n    unless valid_id?(spell_id)\n      bad_request('invalid spell_id')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless valid_non_empty_string?(name)\n      bad_request('invalid name')\n      return\n    end\n\n    unless level.is_a?(Integer)\n      bad_request('invalid level')\n      return\n    end\n\n    campaign_id = params[:id]\n    char_id = params[:char_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      member = GameStorage.db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, owner, class FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?
